description: Check what WhatsApp actually did with messages you already sent — delivered, read, still pending, or FAILED with Meta's own reason. A send tool returning status "sent" only means Meta accepted the message; Meta can still refuse to deliver it seconds later, and this tool is the only way to learn that. Call it a minute or two after sending (pass the message_id values the send tools returned), or pass a phone number to review every recent outbound message to one contact.

message_ids.description: The message_id values returned by the send tools (WhatsApp wamids). Up to 200. Checked exactly, ignoring the time window.

minutes.description: How far back to look when checking by phone. Default 60, maximum 1440 (24 hours). Ignored when message_ids is given.

phone.description: Alternative to message_ids: a contact phone number in international format without +. Reviews every message sent TO that contact inside the time window. Use this for the send tools that return no message_id (buttons, list, carousel, reply, reaction).

name: get_message_status
